response.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin AS r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * order_count / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS count_over_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY scope;
